appearance.organs.flower.shape.template.note: FNA's account of the genus: each flowering stem bears a head of white rays round a disc of yellow florets, drawn on a head card whatever the family's characters say.

appearance.organs.leaf.shape.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, Chrysanthemum leucanthemum (p. 394): stem leaves sessile, clasping, incised, reduced upward. Photographs (iNaturalist observations 170263172, 290839324) show them oblong to oblanceolate, about a quarter as wide as long, with a broad clasping foot and many small rounded teeth on both edges; drawn so, the foot narrowing a little above the clasp.

appearance.organs.flower.accent.note: The disc deep golden yellow, toward orange, not pale: about sRGB (240, 185, 20) on the face-on heads (observations 119225591, 198086066, 77287435, 12714687), the centre greener while its inner florets are in bud.

traits.ray_apex.note: The same eight heads: every ray's tip cut square to rounded, with two or three small teeth (observations 119225591, 198086066, 77287435, 12714687 show them best).

traits.ray_width_m.note: Rays measured on eight face-on heads (observations 119225591, 116604189, 14371808, 165636587, 198086066, 77287435, 181526174, 12714687): each about a quarter as wide as long (0.17 to 0.30, median 0.24), parallel-sided from near the foot almost to the tip; times FNA's 12 to 20 mm rays, 3 to 5 mm wide, 2 to 6 at the extremes (our arithmetic). Neighbouring rays touch or overlap near the disc and part toward their tips.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: an introduced daisy: clumps of stems with toothed leaves, each stem topped by a white-rayed head with a yellow centre. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 0.6 m tall at 4 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: dark green leaves; white and yellow heads.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.note: FNA's account of the species: plants 10 to 30 cm tall, as tall as 100 cm or more; involucres 12 to 20 mm across or more; ray florets usually 13 to 34 or more, rarely none; their laminae 12 to 20 mm long, as long as 35 mm or more.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, Chrysanthemum leucanthemum (p. 394): stems erect, 2-8 dm high, from a creeping rhizome. Replaces the spec's 0.1-0.3 (high 1.0); see disagreements.

traits.life_span.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, Chrysanthemum leucanthemum (p. 394): perennial.

traits.woodiness.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, Chrysanthemum leucanthemum (p. 394): a perennial herb.

traits.rhizome_habit.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, Chrysanthemum leucanthemum (p. 394): from a creeping rhizome.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, Chrysanthemum leucanthemum (p. 394): basal leaves 4-10 cm long counting the petiole; stem leaves shorter, reduced upwards.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, Chrysanthemum leucanthemum (p. 394): basal blades shorter than their petioles, so the petiole is over half of the 4-10 cm leaf (our arithmetic); stem leaves sessile, clasping.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, Chrysanthemum leucanthemum (p. 394): basal leaves spatulate or obovate.

traits.leaf_incision.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, Chrysanthemum leucanthemum (p. 394): basal leaves often cut pinnatifid toward the base, crenate or toothed toward the tip; stem leaves incised.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, Chrysanthemum leucanthemum (p. 394): crenate or toothed toward the apex.

traits.rosette.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, Chrysanthemum leucanthemum (p. 394): distinct long-petioled basal leaves, the stem leaves sessile and reduced upward.

traits.inflorescence.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, Chrysanthemum leucanthemum (p. 394): heads on long bracteate peduncles, the stem simple or sparingly branched; heads 3-5 cm across with rays.

traits.ray_colour.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, Chrysanthemum leucanthemum (p. 394): rays many, white, linear, 14-21 mm long. Word: white.

traits.disc_colour.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, Chrysanthemum leucanthemum (p. 394): disc florets yellow. Word: yellow.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, Chrysanthemum leucanthemum (p. 394): achenes about 2 mm long, dark with 8-10 white ribs.

traits.flowering_months.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, Chrysanthemum leucanthemum (p. 394): June to September.
